name: create_icon_set
description: Create a consistent set of simple icons as SVG files and optional PNG exports from a style brief and icon names list.

iconNames.description: Names/labels for each icon (e.g. home, settings, user).

designBrief.description: Visual style: stroke weight, corner radius, palette, metaphor constraints.

outputDir.description: Directory under workspace/ for outputs (e.g. icons/). Default icons/.

pngSize.description: PNG export size in pixels (square). Default 512.
